body:
Found in an independent adversarial review of #1007 (head `612860e4`). Medium (scope of "Fixes #1008").

**Where:** `refresh_unchanged_cohort.py` (around lines 30–32), added for #1008.

**What happens:** it hard-codes `BASELINE=4625afd` plus the prior and successor review paths, and the successor pins base review `0cc2c874…`. Any later canonical-SSSOM change reproduces the exact #1008 CI failure and needs another hand-built successor and helper.

**Suggested fix:** take the baseline and paths as CLI parameters, move the helper to `scripts/` (or `src/`) with a test, and either keep #1008 open or track the generalisation here.
title: refresh_unchanged_cohort.py hard-codes its baseline and review paths, so #1008 recurs on the next SSSOM change
